watch.summary: The streamer carefully times a jump in a physics platforming game as an egg and loudly celebrates successfully making it across.

beats.what: The streamer counts aloud as the egg rolls along a tight obstacle course.
The egg lands smoothly on the far wooden platform.
The streamer yells in hype, celebrating how clean the jump was.
